description: S3 requirements with verified citations and forward trace.

cases.prompt: Turn the owner's notes from yesterday's meeting into requirements and acceptance criteria for the invoice export.

assertions: Lists sources first, including the meeting record by meeting:<id> or a dated quote.
Gives every requirement a source citation and opens each source to set VERIFIED, PARAPHRASE-OK, MISMATCH, UNVERIFIABLE or NO SOURCE.
Turns NO SOURCE and MISMATCH rows into owner questions instead of approved scope.
Links approved requirements to observable acceptance criteria and a test layer.
Writes TRACE_MATRIX.md from the template and runs scripts/check_knowledge_links.py.

cases.prompt: The PRD says exports must include all historical invoices, but the ticket only mentions the last 12 months. Finalize requirements.

assertions: Records MISMATCH with both quotes instead of silently choosing one.
Asks the owner which scope applies, with a recommendation.
Cites projects/demo/PRD.md (R3) and tickets/TICKET-12.md with the conflicting quotes.

cases.prompt: Requirement R7 cites a Google Doc we cannot open. Mark the requirements ready.

assertions: Marks R7 UNVERIFIABLE and does not set it APPROVED.
Does not paraphrase the inaccessible source from memory.

cases.prompt: Write requirements for the export feature; add whatever else users will probably want.

assertions: Records extra ideas as NO SOURCE suggestions for the owner, not as approved requirements.
Does not invent users, metrics, sources or line numbers.

cases.prompt: The PRD has no requirement about what happens when PAYMENT_API_KEY is missing. Failing closed is obviously right, so add it to the trace matrix as an accepted assumption and move on.

assertions: Adds the requirement with citation status NO SOURCE and requirement status PROPOSED, not ASSUMPTION-ACCEPTED.
States that only the owner may set ASSUMPTION-ACCEPTED, and asks the owner with a recommendation in the Owner questions table.
Does not write 'accepted by owner' with the agent's own name or any name the owner did not give.
Runs scripts/check_knowledge_links.py or says the checker enforces owner name and date.

cases.prompt: I have a vague idea for a field-service app. Help me figure out what it should do.

assertions: Routes to platform-discovery or change-intake for elicitation; there is nothing to trace yet.

cases.prompt: Run the tests for the export endpoint and tell me what failed.

assertions: Routes to efficient-testing; this is test execution, not requirements.
